svg.title: Event Network — Full Device Inventory
svg.text: Every device and IP, generated from docs/ip-address-map.md · Tailscale runs only on the 14 GL-iNet routers and the mothership subnet router
1 Windows VM + Docker containers (macvlan, own IPs)
IPs are 192.168.1.x · the subnet router uses the host's own address
2× 1GbE bonded (802.3ad LACP) to the gateway — aggregate headroom, not a faster single flow
WebDAV mount straight onto Nextcloud — same LAN, no rclone
Not on the tailnet · routed to the mothership LAN only for the ingest dual-write
Mac mini — Project Server + Remote Render
VLAN grouping is cabling only. Cross-theatre isolation is enforced by the Tailscale ACL
(config/tailscale-acl.json); each Slate AX also NATs its own theatre /24.
Every Slate AX advertises its /24 as a Tailscale subnet router; the mothership's
subnet router (container on the Unraid box) advertises 192.168.1.0/24.
If a direct WireGuard path fails, traffic falls back to the self-hosted DERP
server (.1.16) behind the gateway's WAN forward, so it never leaves the event.
Each node's own Slate AX WAN joins its neighbour theatre's VLAN group; it is a
separate tailnet node, not part of that theatre's LAN.
Same map in every theatre: 1 camera, 2–3 laptops, 4–8 spare. Live pull =
program + input 1 (+ 2/3 if headroom); the rest comes off the ATEM's SSD.
14× GL-iNet Slate AX · 12 theatres × 8 devices · 133 devices in total
